vocab_partition.method: torch.randperm on private CPU generator, balanced equal groups

head.normalization: parameter-free RMSNorm separately within each D-dimensional stream
head.objective: one global full-vocabulary softmax; CCE return_lse with exact differentiable global recombination

final_mixing.layout: [B,T,D,4] -> tokenwise dynamic4x4 Sinkhorn -> [B,T,D,4] -> per-stream RMSNorm -> partitioned global softmax
final_mixing.bias_logits: identity4x4, same as layer residual mixing
final_mixing.backend: Unmodified NVIDIA TE projection/scale/Sinkhorn/expand-combine; zero branch, no extra attention/MLP
final_mixing.optimizer: same routing AdamW group, default unembedding LR and zero weight decay

optimizer: Unchanged native MuonAdamW rules and LR schedule; no LR sweep

reference.role: Previously completed ordinary mHC control, same data/seed/hyperparameters
reference.caveat: New CCE composition changes numerical kernel shapes; per-stream final normalization replaces collapse then normalization. One seed cannot establish a general advantage.

partition.role: Existing independently trained10B control; do not modify or restart

motivation.claim: Each vocabulary partition can read a learned mixture of all four final streams while preserving four outputs and a KD dimensional upper bound
caveats: Sinkhorn does not guarantee full rank or well conditioning.
A fixed full-rank4x4 mix preserves a full-rank block-diagonal linear head; dynamic input Jacobian and RMSNorm are distinct.
Identical streams remain identical under exact doubly stochastic mixing; this tests learned specialization, not an immediate repair of collapsed features.
Not an arbitrary dense KD-to-V head: vocabulary rows in each partition share their stream-mixing coefficients.
